I've written the canopy chart and handed it back to Idli. Idli will draw it from your real data. I only rendered it on the fake mock data, so those numbers mean nothing.

The chart is a horizontal bar chart of the share of trees with canopy, per transect, sorted highest first. Each bar is labelled with its percentage and the "n of N" count, and the overall share is in the title. It counts only trees where canopy is recorded as Y or N. Trees with a blank canopy value are left out of both the count and the total. If there are more than 15 transects, the rest are grouped into "Others". If there is no canopy data, it shows "No data".

You answered "You decide" when I asked whether the fake-data picture looked right, so I took that as approval. If you want changes, tell me and I'll adjust it.

I didn't change the skill, so it's still version 1. The chart is in `file-skills/tree_plots_transects/charts/canopy_share.py`. I also created the go-back file, so Idli's watcher should switch you back to Idli.
